//: A PC asks 'which workspace am I in?' with a collection-group query: members (and invites) across every workspace, by the signed-in address. Firestore indexes a field automatically only within one collection, so a group query needs the field listed here with COLLECTION_GROUP scope, or it is refused with 400 FAILED_PRECONDITION. The emulator does not enforce this, which is why the rules tests passed while the live service refused the same query (app.ts logged workspace-check-failed). A fieldOverride replaces the automatic indexing for that field, so the three ordinary scopes are repeated here alongside the group one.
